C-SQUASH-WITNESS-2-29EFA92A.Summary: Supersede C-SQUASH-WITNESS-1-87D77A3D to remove invalid inode-dependent CI evidence before designing the coordinator. Retain the independent C6 content and explicit-boundary witness. Repair test metrics so removing tests from an existing file yields a measured artifact.

Goals.Goal: Remove the recycled-inode controls, direct identity assertions, descriptor and pin lifecycle tests, their exclusive historical fixture, duplicate loaders, verifier, and CI-only second suite.
Keep the C6 archive content witness, its twelve-path inventory, explicit-boundary git checks, and unrelated functional serialization tests.
Make test:metrics record the executed JUnit case set after a test is removed within an existing file, without rerunning the suite or rewriting unchanged metrics.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-METRICS-MEASURED: test:metrics runs the suite once. A canonical SHA-256 digest over the sorted relative paths and raw bytes of discovered test files is an integrity pin, not a lock; artifactIsStale compares it with the committed artifact, so a same-file test deletion, one-byte test edit, addition, or removal is stale. The provisional artifact carries that digest so the in-suite freshness guard can pass; an interrupted provisional artifact triggers a measured replacement on the next run. After the suite, compare the observed JUnit case identities with multiplicity against the artifact and write measured cases when they differ even if the source digest did not. An unchanged digest and case multiset leave the committed artifact byte-identical, excluding timing churn. Refuse a test-source digest change during the measured run. Final test-metrics.json has no provisional cases and its test identities/counts equal that run's JUnit. A focused unit test and a real small-project runner probe drive same-file deletion red, measured replacement green, unchanged-run byte invariance, and provisional recovery.

C-SQUASH-WITNESS-2-29EFA92A.Problem: C-SQUASH-WITNESS-1-87D77A3D is active with an approved plan that demands recycled-inode behavior from a historical b53d13d source tree and an exact-head Ubuntu JUnit artifact. The filesystem-recycling precondition is unreliable and its skip can give a green test exit without executing the asserted behavior. The extra Validate chain repeats work and still cannot prove serialization. Direct identity and descriptor-lifecycle tests assert the discarded mechanism. Meanwhile the C6 content witness in the same bundle is independent and remains useful. Removing tests inside existing files also leaves scripts/test-metrics.ts artifactIsStale false when its filename list and internal sum are self-consistent; the runner then preserves old counts. This successor repairs that measurement while retiring the invalid evidence. It supersedes the approved predecessor rather than editing it.
